explicit_non_claims: This fixture does not identify the Kirby invariant with Crane-Yetter.
This fixture does not import a concrete category snapshot.
This fixture does not validate a numerical experiment artifact.
This fixture does not replace the Lean proof.
R10 does not re-prove Cerf theory in Lean.
R10 does not derive the Table 2 refinement from general Cerf theory in Lean.
R10 does not contain or prove an evaluator equality.
R10 does not yet define the twisted four-manifold invariant.
R10 does not identify that invariant with Crane-Yetter.
lean_proves: the general and special move whitelists are distinct types
special movies compose only typed Table 2 moves
every special move carries an H2 equivalence
derived character transport preserves every pairing
trusted_topology_inputs: general Cerf completeness for compact relative handle decompositions

general_cerf.exact_scope: two ordered relative handle decompositions of one compact smooth pair (X, boundary-minus X)
general_cerf.source_locator: Definition 4.2.1, Theorem 4.2.12, and Proposition 4.2.13, printed pages 104 and 110-111
general_cerf.source_scope_caveat: Theorem 4.2.12 contains all adjacent-index births and deaths and index-three slides; it is not by itself the five-family Table 2 link theorem.

table_two_link_refinement.source_locator: Bärenz-Barrett Theorem 3.9 and Table 2, journal pages 685-687; Gompf-Stipsicz Section 5.1, printed pages 139-148; de Sa, pages 16-30
table_two_link_refinement.source_scope_caveat: Lean does not derive the special link calculus from general Cerf theory. This refinement is a separately visible topology input and is exactly where a source scope error must fail.

trusted_inputs.exact_content: One content-addressed category interpretation coherently supplies generalized sliding data, normalization dimensions, and closed-diagram scalarization.
trusted_inputs.not_assumed: No concrete category snapshot is imported and no Crane-Yetter identification is supplied.

trusted_inputs.exact_content: For every special presentation and marked class, the typed diagram and decoration realize that formal presentation and class, and its raw numerator is the scalarized categorical evaluation.
trusted_inputs.not_assumed: No final value equality and no presentation independence.

trusted_inputs.exact_content: Every R10 topology move and every marked class is realized by the exact corresponding closed R7, R8, or R9 proof object.
trusted_inputs.not_assumed: The field returns proof objects, never a bare normalized equality.

trusted_inputs.exact_content: Certified coordinates representing the same geometric class are related by the exact H2 transport of the R10 completeness movie.
trusted_inputs.not_assumed: No evaluator statement and no state-sum or Crane-Yetter identification.
